dataset.name: TCGA Pan-Cancer Atlas Gene Expression
dataset.description: Open-access TCGA Pan-Cancer Atlas batch-adjusted RNA-seq gene expression for 33 cancer types, paired with curated clinical outcomes and sample quality annotations from the NCI Genomic Data Commons publication release.

files.description: Batch-adjusted, upper-quartile-normalized RNA-seq expression for 20,531 genes across 11,069 TCGA samples; genes are rows and sample barcodes are columns. The web preview is limited to the first 25 columns.
Curated TCGA Clinical Data Resource patient characteristics and recommended survival outcome endpoints.
Pan-Cancer Atlas patient, sample, and aliquot quality annotations across molecular platforms.
